simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to שָׂגָה (H7685) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: שָׂגָה (sâgâh) means to enlarge (especially upward, also figuratively) First listed occurrence: Job 8 7.

definitions.full: H7685. sagah [ שָׂגָה ] verb grow, increase (late; || form of שׂגא ); — Qal Imperfect 3masculine singular יִשְׂגֶּה Psa 92:13 righteous shall grow great like cedar (|| יִפְרַח ), compare Job 8:7 (opposed to מִצְעָר ; 8:11 see שׂגא ). Hiph`il Perfect 3plural הִשְׂגּוּחַֿיִל Psa 73:12 they have increased riches . שׂגיב see שְׂגוּב . שִׂגְשֵׂג see II. סוּג ..
